snapshot.body:
The public Cloudflare website is deployed and verified, but the ongoing publication planner/handoff still represents primary delivery using a ChatGPT Site-specific schema. The successful CF deployment must become a discoverable verified baseline for future compatible main changes; it must not be represented as a fabricated Site version.

Current CF baseline: primary80fb0e7744809438d02881f8d3435d9efb71d2e8, native CF deployment6850090217, Worker7223b2fa-1a51-4a31-a34a-bdeb1b92bef4, published geographic6. Settlement https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/822#issuecomment-5987131945 ; acceptance https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/822#issuecomment-5987131625 . Existing Site delivery/history and native Neon operations remain immutable.

Acceptance:
- Review and implement explicit Cloudflare primary publication discovery, deployment and verified delivery receipts; retain readable historical Site/Neon/CF records. No blind bootstrap rewrite or fabricated delivery.
- Pin main at run start; classify source-only research separately; deploy compatible code/assets against the matching published geographic release. Future updates must reach Cloudflare without reviving the static6/database5 mismatch.
- Preserve serialized operations, exact reviewed source/data/lookup/asset pins, scope claims, independent premerge evidence review, CI, rollback and per-issue acceptance discovery.
- Keep the existing Neon compact design, credentials hidden, public browsing without login and public mutations blocked. Publication control remains distinct from public website writes.
- Update repository publisher handoff/role instructions. Inspect existing saved publisher instructions or schedules before changing them; if schedule updates are necessary, update existing authorized jobs rather than creating duplicate schedules. Never add new schedules just to satisfy this issue.
- Verify through a bounded serialized Cloudflare publisher run and matching actual served/API/frontend checks; record the actual baseline and pending archive residuals honestly.

Refs #822 for completed public hosting; #6 for geographic publication history. This task does not transfer inaccessible old archives or retire/delete the old Site.
